notes: Catalog of Hunspell dictionaries smaragd hosts and can download on request (Settings > Spell Check > Dictionaries, src/spellcheck.rs, GitHub issue #47). This file itself is compiled into the smaragd binary (include_str!), but each entry's actual dictionary files live in a separate repo, https://github.com/ljantzen/smaragd-dictionaries/<language_code>/, each with its own SOURCE (exact upstream commit pinned, never a moving branch) and LICENSE (the upstream license text, verbatim) -- see that repo's README.md for the full explanation of why redistributing a non-GPL or even GPL-2.0-only dictionary is fine (GPLv2's own 'mere aggregation' allowance: these stay independent, unmodified, un-linked data files, never compiled or linked into the application). `redistributable`/`review_status` reflect this project's own reading of the upstream license/README files at the pinned commit, not a legal opinion for any other use case.

dictionary_source_policy.description: Only individually reviewed dictionary artifacts -- pinned to an exact upstream commit, with their license text preserved verbatim and their copyright holder identified -- are distributed. A dictionary whose review_status starts with "blocked" is never offered for download regardless of what its own license technically permits.
dictionary_source_policy.license_isolation: Every dictionary is kept as a genuinely separate, unmodified file (own LICENSE/SOURCE, never compiled or linked into smaragd's own source or binary) so its license never applies to smaragd's own code, and smaragd's GPL-3.0-or-later never applies to it.

dictionaries.copyright: Copyright 2000-2016 by Kevin Atkinson (SCOWL word list); Copyright 1993, Geoff Kuenning (Ispell-derived affix file). Full attribution chain in en_US/LICENSE.
dictionaries.review_status_notes: Corroborated two independent ways: reading the dictionary's own upstream README directly (a permissive Kevin Atkinson grant, not GPL, despite an unrelated bare-GPLv2 file sitting elsewhere in a different upstream mirror of the same data), and wooorm/dictionaries -- a separately maintained aggregator -- independently classifying this exact file as "(MIT AND BSD)" in its own package metadata.

dictionaries.copyright: Not explicitly stated beyond "The spell-norwegian project" / no.speling.org (publisher); nb_NO.aff credits Arno Teigseth for a specific rule addition (2010). Full text in nb_NO/LICENSE.
dictionaries.review_status_notes: No per-file "or any later version" grant found anywhere upstream (corroborated by wooorm/dictionaries independently classifying its own copy as plain "GPL-2.0", not "-or-later") -- treated as GPL-2.0-only. Redistributable here specifically because it's kept as a genuinely separate, unmodified data file under GPLv2's own mere-aggregation allowance, not combined/linked into smaragd's GPL-3.0-or-later source or binary -- see dictionary_source_policy above and nb_NO/SOURCE.
